# em portageq envvar

Print profile variable values by name

## Usage

```
em portageq envvar [OPTIONS] [NAME]...
```

## Arguments

* `[NAME]...`

## Options

* `-v` — Print NAME='value' instead of bare values
* `-h, --help` — Print help (see a summary with '-h')

## Global options

* `--color <WHEN>` — \[default: auto\] \[possible values: auto, always, never\]
